estimates: The heritage boundary and road trace establish the location and plan. Exact pier stations, spring heights, parapets and visible foundations are estimates.
A written first-person description records six exposed arches immediately downstream of the Intermediate Reservoir. Their individual widths are estimated.

The 5 m elevation grid represents original surveyed ground and the reservoir surface. Submerged foundations and channel depths are outside the available data. Near-deck apparent sculpting in the elevation model is kept in the preview.

review.notes: Started with the Qualla trail and reservoir stories. The bridge photograph uses an attribution/share-alike license. Used the geographical outline, mapped road, original survey terrain and written engineering records. No appearance imagery used.
